social_activities:
Closely associated with the successful management and functioning of Gaushala; played an active role in 
Gau-Seva Sangh Sanstha, Sagar, Madhya Pradesh for the cause of cow protection; engage youth in the constructive work for removing the barriers of caste and class; and making efforts for the development of orphanages and Deaf and Dumb schools and old age homes
Regular participation in social and cultural activities and promoting such activities, helping in providing opportunities to talented people to progress, campaign to unite people to be vegetarian, making society aware against drinking and smoking. Making efforts for social, economic and educational improvement of the people and encouraging them to be self-dependent.
interests:
Helping the people in distress by raising their economic and social status; and providing medical facilities and also by extending social and economic support to the lowest of the lowest strata of society and instill a sense of self respect in them.
Launching campaign against child labour, encouraging parents to send their wards to school who could not get education and obtaining information regarding educational standard of students and schools after visiting schools from time to time and drawing attention towards improvement in them. Enhancing cooperation and social participation of doctors with a view to improving the healthcare facilities.
sports: Hockey, kabaddi, chess and cricket; won a number of prizes in race events at State level
countries_visited: Australia, China, Mongolia, Russia and Thailand

other_information:
RSS worker since childhood; Branch Head, RSS; Actively participated in the Total Revolution movement started by Lok Nayak Jayaprakash Narayan 
in 1975; went to Sagar and Jabalpur jails for 16 months under Maintenance of Internal Security 
Act (MISA) in protest against imposition of Emergency; started movement for solving the 
problems faced by students and opened library for their assistance; joined politics in 1982 and 
since then actively associated with the National, State, local movements and programmes 
initiated by B.J.P.
